title: Métronome
description: Simultaneous moves on a real clock. Both players secretly program three ticks, then the measure plays out at once: bounces, duels at the centre, eliminations. Read your opponent, not the board. Play hotseat, against an honest AI, or online with a friend in a LOB7 room.
controls: For each of the three ticks, give each of your pieces one of six directions or stay.
Two enemy pieces aimed at the same cell eliminate each other; blocked moves bounce.
Hold the centre alone at the end of two consecutive measures to win.
Hotseat: pass the device when the handoff screen appears.
credits: A game by Cédric Bernadac, created with AI agents (ZCode & Kimi K3.1 Pro).
